title: Catechol functionalized polyguluronate enriched sodium alginate wetspun fibers with immobilized platelet lysate for diabetic wound healing
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,14328-14349
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00827E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hafsa Khanam, Ashraful Hoque, Mohammad A. Jafar Mazumder, M. Tarik Arafat
Catechol-functionalized alginate–PEG wet-spun fibers were polydopamine-coated and loaded with platelet lysate for sustained release. In diabetic mice, the dressing increased fibroblast proliferation, angiogenesis, and accelerated wound healing.
